verdict.rationale: Copilot offers a CLI (docs-26, probe-4) and MCP server integration (docs-25) that give some programmatic access to Copilot/GitHub features, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive public API/OpenAPI spec covering the full range of UI capabilities (chat, agent mode, cloud agent, code review) — the openapi probe returned 404 for all candidate endpoints (probe-3). Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API exposing chat, agent-mode edits, cloud-agent orchestration, and code review equivalently to the UI, and any independent confirmation that CLI/MCP covers full feature parity.
